芯片的起点，有金属般的光泽: The metallic lustre behind a microchip.
一层氧化膜，让金属有了彩虹: A thin oxide film brings a rainbow.
常温下，金属也能是液体: A metal that flows at room temperature.

这块天然铜重 44 克。铜能被拉成细线，也善于导电，因此常见于电线和电机。矿石中: This native copper nugget weighs 44 grams. Copper can be drawn into fine wires and conducts electricity well. Most copper must be extracted from ores; this specimen is native copper.
这枚天然硫晶体重 5 克。硫可以以单质形式存在于自然界；黄铁矿虽然也含硫，却是铁: This natural sulfur crystal weighs 5 grams. Sulfur occurs in nature in elemental form. Pyrite also contains sulfur, but it is a compound of iron and sulfur, a different material.
高纯硅呈灰色，表面有金属般的光泽。它用于半导体芯片。沙子中常见的石英是二氧化硅，: High-purity silicon is grey with a metallic lustre. It is used in semiconductor chips. Quartz, common in sand, is silicon dioxide rather than pure silicon.
照片里的台阶状晶体由铋形成，表面覆盖氧化膜。彩色来自表面薄膜的光学效应，不代表铋: This stepped bismuth crystal has an oxide film on its surface. Optical effects in the thin film produce the colours; the metal inside is not rainbow-coloured.
照片中的纯汞重 6 克。常温下它呈银白色液态；Hg 来自意为“液态银”的拉丁名称: The photograph shows 6 grams of pure mercury. It is a silvery liquid at room temperature. Hg comes from the Latin name meaning liquid silver. Mercury is toxic; this photograph is for observation.
密封瓶中是单质溴。常温下，溴与汞都是液体，但溴属于非金属。它有挥发性，真实照片保: The sealed vial holds elemental bromine. Like mercury, bromine is liquid at room temperature, but it is a nonmetal. It is volatile; the photograph retains its glass container.
瓶中是高纯氧气。照片展示放电时的辉光，普通条件下的氧气是无色的。气体的发光照片，: The vial contains high-purity oxygen. The photograph shows its glow during electrical discharge. Oxygen is normally colourless; a glowing gas photograph does not show its ordinary appearance.
鿫通过核反应合成，已知同位素迅速衰变。我们没有可供拍摄的一块鿫。这个空展柜保留它: Oganesson is made in nuclear reactions, and its known isotopes decay rapidly. There is no bulk piece to photograph. This empty case keeps its place in the table without inventing its appearance.
选择一层，查看其中的电子数。: Select a shell to highlight its electron count.
史前已知；铜与锡的合金青铜，曾被用来制造工具与钟。: Known since prehistory. Bronze, an alloy of copper and tin, was used for tools and bells.
电线、电机、屋顶与换热器。铜兼有导电、导热与延展性。: Wires, motors, roofs and heat exchangers. Copper combines electrical and thermal conductivity with ductility.
硫在古代已被认识，能以单质形式出现在火山地区。: Sulfur was known in antiquity. It occurs in elemental form in volcanic regions.
制造硫酸，也用于橡胶硫化。硫元素与不同硫化合物的性质差别很大。: Used to make sulfuric acid and vulcanise rubber. Elemental sulfur and its compounds have very different properties.
1824 年，贝采里乌斯分离出了硅。名字来自表示燧石的拉丁词。: Berzelius isolated silicon in 1824. Its name comes from the Latin word for flint.
高纯硅用于芯片与太阳能电池；含硅化合物还出现在玻璃与建筑材料中。: High-purity silicon is used in chips and solar cells. Silicon compounds appear in glass and construction materials.
铋曾被与铅、锡混淆。它常见的天然同位素铋-209具有极长的半衰期。: Bismuth was once confused with lead and tin. Its common natural isotope, bismuth-209, has an extremely long half-life.
铋用于低熔点合金；部分铋化合物用于医药。晶体表面的氧化膜带来丰富颜色。: Bismuth is used in low-melting alloys; some compounds have medical uses. A surface oxide film colours these crystals.
汞在古代已被认识。它的液态特征使它曾被用于温度计与气压计。: Known in antiquity. Its liquid state made mercury useful in thermometers and barometers.
历史上用于测温、测压与汞合金。由于毒性，许多用途已被其他材料替代。: Historically used in temperature and pressure measurement and amalgams. Toxicity has led to replacement in many uses.
1826 年，巴拉尔发表了溴的发现；勒维希也曾独立获得这种物质。: Balard published his discovery of bromine in 1826; Löwig also obtained it independently.
溴化银用于传统感光材料；部分含溴化合物用于阻燃。用途对应化合物，并不等于单质溴。: Silver bromide is used in photographic materials; some bromine compounds are flame retardants. These are uses of compounds, not elemental bromine.
普里斯特利与舍勒分别制得氧气；拉瓦锡帮助解释了它在燃烧中的作用。: Priestley and Scheele independently prepared oxygen. Lavoisier helped explain its role in combustion.
氧气用于炼钢与医疗供氧。常温氧气无色，放电辉光与低温液氧的颜色是不同条件下的现象: Oxygen is used in steelmaking and medical oxygen supply. It is normally colourless; discharge glow and the colour of cold liquid oxygen arise under different conditions.
色深对应数值；— 表示缺少数据。密度与相变取决于测量条件。: Darker shades indicate larger values; — means missing data. Density and phase transitions depend on measurement conditions.
数值随压力、温度与同素异形体而异；详见来源。: Values depend on pressure, temperature and allotrope; see sources.
此电子排布包含理论预测。: This electron configuration includes theoretical predictions.
碳在常压下升华；所列熔沸点不能作为常压加热顺序。: Carbon sublimes at ordinary pressure; the listed thermal values are not an ordinary-pressure heating sequence.
氦的熔点需要加压条件，常压下不能这样凝固。: The helium melting point requires increased pressure; helium does not freeze this way at ordinary pressure.
砷在常压下升华；所列熔点约对应 28 个大气压。: Arsenic sublimes at ordinary pressure; the listed melting point is at about 28 atmospheres.

两个原子核融合，再逸出中子；图中演示的是一次成功反应。: Two nuclei fuse and then emit neutrons. The animation shows one successful reaction.
棕色代表质子，青色代表中子。一次动画只展示一种合成通道，不代表每次碰撞都能成功；: Brown represents protons and teal represents neutrons. The animation shows one synthesis channel, not the probability of success. The product can subsequently decay.

示意图为原创绘制，反应依据来自所链接的实验记录；没有用生成图片冒充元素照片。: This original schematic is based on the linked experiment record. It is not a generated specimen photograph.
依据实拍统一版式；实验细节以原图为准。: Presentation adapted from a real photograph; see the original for experimental details.

单轨道，非整个原子。: One orbital, not the whole atom.
